documents.title: VIBECODER-DISCOVERY-ISSUES
documents.content:
Vibe Coder discovery — diagnosis, verification & fix strategy .. edited by Bakhtawar

> Source of evidence: `Transcript.html` (a real QuitProCo discovery session, 20 Jun 2026 10:52–11:19)

> plus the orchestrator instructions and the client action sources. Each cause below is marked

> Confirmed (proven in code + transcript) or Likely (strong inference, needs a quick check).

---

The three reported symptoms

1. Website loop — the user says "I don't have a website" three times (11:12, 11:16, again implied

at 11:19) yet the bot keeps asking for it.

2. Logo does nothing — the user asks "can you build me one?" / "show me a real logo"; the bot

produces briefs, palettes and "AI image prompts" but never generates an actual logo.

3. "Build the product" gets lost — after the user picks Build the product (11:18), the bot

replies "First I need to understand the business… What's your business website?" — i.e. it

abandons the build and re-enters discovery.

---

Problem A — the website re-ask loop

Root causes

  • A1 (Confirmed). "No website" is never persisted. When the user says they have no site, the bot

saves nothing to represent that. The `Business` record only has a `website` string; there is no

"asked, none exists" signal. `MyBusiness.describeState` therefore keeps listing `website` as a

missing section forever, and every instruction pass that mentions website re-triggers the ask.

- Evidence: `save_business` payloads in the transcript (11:15, 11:16) never include `website`; the

bot re-asks at 11:15 ("do you have a website for QuitProCo yet?") and 11:19.

  • A2 (Confirmed). The instructions lead with "ask for the website" and have no "no website" branch.

- `public/html/bot/workmaster/focus/business.md:12-13` — *"Step 1 — Identity: website → … Start by

asking the owner for their business website."*

- `public/html/bot/workmaster/base-instructions.md:94` — *"Identity first. Ask the owner for their

business website."*

- Neither says "if they have no website, record that and never ask again." The only fallback

(`business.md:32`) is for `read_website` errors, not for "I don't have one."

  • A3 (Confirmed). On re-entry the bot does not call `get_business` first, so it re-discovers from

scratch even though the profile is already saved. At 11:19 ("Build the product") it asks for the

website again despite name/what-we-do/who-we-are/problems all being saved at 11:15–11:16.

How to verify

  • Inspect the saved `businesses` doc for this org: `business.website` will be absent/empty and

there will be no "no website" flag → confirms A1.

  • Re-run: complete discovery, say "no website", then type "build the product" → bot re-asks website

→ confirms A2/A3. (Also visible verbatim in the transcript.)

---

Problem B — "build me a logo" produces only text, never an image

Root causes

  • B1 (Confirmed). There is no logo/image-generation action exposed to the bot. The orchestrator's

client actions are only `get_business`, `read_website`, `save_business`

(`src/buildui/wm/vibe/actions/WMBaseActions.ts`). No `generate_logo` / `generate_image` /

`generate_palette` action exists in any action class (grep across `vibe/actions/` finds none).

So the bot literally cannot produce an image — it can only describe one, which is exactly what the

transcript shows (briefs, palettes, "AI image prompts", brand kits, on a loop).

  • B2 (Confirmed). The capability already exists server-side but is unwired. SLS has

`GenerateImageViaOpenRouter.ts`, `GeneratePaletteViaOpenRouter.ts`, `GetImageModelList.ts`,

`LogoAssetService.ts`; RSDK has `GenerateImageViaOpenRouter.ts`, `GeneratePaletteViaOpenRouter.ts`,

`GetImageModelList.ts`. None are called from a vibecoder action. **The plumbing is there; the bot

just has no handle to it.**

  • B3 (Confirmed). The instructions never tell the bot it cannot draw, so it over-promises ("Yes —

I can help you create one", 11:15/11:17) and then stalls on prompt-writing.

  • B4 (Confirmed, secondary). Branding colours are saved as prose, not hex. The 11:15

`save_business` stored `branding.colors: ["dark theme","magenta-purple","yellow highlights"]`. The

`Business` model + home swatches expect hex (`#RRGGBB`), so brand colours render wrong / not at all.

How to verify

  • Grep the action sources for an image/logo action → none → confirms B1.
  • Confirm the RSDK/SLS generate-image calls exist (they do) → confirms B2 (capability present).
  • Inspect saved `branding.colors` → non-hex strings → confirms B4.

---

Problem C — "Build the product" abandons the build and re-discovers

Root causes

  • C1 (Confirmed). The bot has no action to start a build. A build is UI-driven: clicking a

problem fires `OPEN_PICKER` → the solution picker → `BUILD_SOLUTION` → `WorkAreaThis` navigates to

the builder, which emits `VIBE_FOCUS_TOPIC` and that is what re-points the bot to the builder

topic. (`WorkAreaThis.ts:75` `OPEN_PICKER`, `:275` `openPicker`.) There is no chat action

(`build_solution` / `open_picker` / `start_build`) the orchestrator can call to initiate this.

  • C2 (Confirmed). So "build" falls back to discovery. base-instructions ("Building solutions",

:18-23) says "follow the focused module's guidance… send `question: 'list actions'`". With **no

focus set** and only the base actions available, `list actions` (fired at 11:19:03 in the

transcript) returns nothing buildable → the bot improvises and loops back to "let's understand the

business… what's your website?" (compounding Problem A).

  • C3 (Clarification). The bot does NOT switch focus. Focus only switches when the work area

navigates (user action in the UI). The bot has no way to drive that from chat, which is precisely

why it gets "lost" — there is no chat→build bridge.

How to verify

  • Re-run "build the product" from chat and watch the hidden `question: "list actions"` reply — it

lists only `get_business/read_website/save_business` (no build action) → confirms C1/C2.

  • Confirm no `BUILD_SOLUTION`/`OPEN_PICKER`-emitting action exists in `vibe/actions/` → confirms C1.

---

Secondary finding — choices are mis-split on commas

(Confirmed, low severity.) Choices are a comma-separated string (base-instructions :44). The

bot sent `"Yes, save it,No, change something"`, which split into four buttons — `Yes` / `save it`

/ `No` / `change something` (visible in the transcript's rendered choice lists). Labels that contain

commas break the delimiter. Either forbid commas in labels (instruction) or change the choices

delimiter/format.

---

Strategy — what to do, one by one

Ordered by impact and independence. Each item notes the layer it touches and whether it needs a

`bc.sync` (instruction `.md`), an SLS redeploy, or just a TNGPP rebuild.

1. Stop the website loop (highest impact, mostly instructions)

  • 1a. Persist "no website" as a durable fact. Cheapest: when the user says they have no site,

`save_business` with `website: ""` and record a flag the model can see — either add an explicit

`noWebsite: true` to the `Business` model (TNGPP model + SLS merge + `describeState` treats website

as satisfied when `noWebsite` is true), or repurpose an empty-but-present `website`. *(model/SLS +

bc.sync.)*

  • 1b. Edit `business.md` / `base-instructions.md`: add a "no website" branch — *if the user

has no website, acknowledge once, record it, and never ask again; collect name/what-we-do/who-we-are

by asking directly. (bc.sync.)*

  • 1c. Edit instructions: always `get_business` first on any (re)entry; if identity is already

complete, do not re-run discovery or re-ask the website. (bc.sync.)

  • Verify: saved doc shows the no-website signal; "build the product" no longer re-asks website.

2. Give "build" a real entry point (fixes the dead-end)

  • 2a. Add a client action — e.g. `start_build` / `open_solution_picker` — to the base/business

action set that emits `OPEN_PICKER` (or `BUILD_SOLUTION`) to `WorkAreaThis`, so a chat "build me X"

opens the picker / starts the build and the focus switches the normal way. *(TNGPP actions +

WorkArea wiring.)*

  • 2b. Edit instructions: when the user wants to build, call that action (don't re-discover);

if no problem is chosen yet, help them pick one, then call it. (bc.sync.)

  • Verify: "build the product" opens the picker / a build, instead of re-asking the website.

3. Wire logo / palette generation (turns the dead text loop into a real feature)

  • 3a. Add a `generate_logo` (and optionally `generate_palette`) action that calls the existing

RSDK `GenerateImageViaOpenRouter` / `GeneratePaletteViaOpenRouter`, saves `branding.logoUrl` /

`branding.colors`, and emits `BUSINESS_UPDATED` so the home shows it. *(TNGPP action; RSDK/SLS

already built.)*

  • 3b. Edit instructions: the bot can generate a logo — after at most one concept/colour

confirmation, call `generate_logo`; stop emitting endless briefs/prompts. (bc.sync.)

  • 3c. Normalise `branding.colors` to hex (the palette action returns hex; or coerce on save) so

swatches render. (B4.)

  • Verify: asking for a logo produces an actual image saved to the profile; colours are hex.

4. Fix the choices comma mis-split (quick)

  • Instruction: no commas inside a choice label; or change the choices delimiter/format so labels

can contain commas. (bc.sync, or ChatUI parsing change.)

  • Verify: "Yes, save it,No, change something" renders as two buttons, not four.

---

Suggested order

1 → 2 → 3 → 4. Items 1 and 2 are the core conversational breakage (and 1 partly causes the

re-ask seen in 2's symptom), so they come first; 3 is an additive feature; 4 is cosmetic. Each is

independent enough to ship and verify on its own.
